_doc: Seasons dress the world (design/seasons/seasons-and-calamities-spec.md §5; build item N-4.5.3). The season is each moon's `season` in calendar.json. seasons: per season, `dark` (the times of day that are dark: Hollows walk, witnesses see 55 px, the town's lamps are lit by the first of them at the latest), `dim` (more dark times on a day whose weather is one of `dim_kinds`), `dim_moons` (moon -> more dark times on such a day in that moon), `regrow` (how fast nature mends: × on the days below, 0 nothing regrows), `dry` (wet ground dries that many times faster) and `travel` (days added to every road). dim_kinds: the grey-sky weathers. rivers: the water by moon (`by_moon`: high, low or frozen; normal when not listed); `maps` lists, per map, the water rects (by index in the map's water) that are rivers: in high water they are too deep to wade except on their bridges; frozen, no water is deep anywhere outdoors (ice is walked on) and all standing water and wet ground is ice; `fords`: roads [a, b] that cross a ford and take `ford_days` more in high water. fields: the Mill fields' crops by moon (`by_moon`, the state from that moon until the next listed), each state's ground `material` (grass burns fast), `soaked` (the cells count as wet) and its look on the ground (`color`, `rows`: the furrows or crop rows) and in the wheat stands (`wheat`: colour, height ×, count ×); `maps` gives the field rects per map. regrow: nature's mending (where `maps` lists): a ground cell of `cells` material burnt to ash grows back after that many days, and a prop kind in `props` after that many, both ÷ the season's regrow (rounded up); owners don't mend those kinds.
